media.altText: Black-and-white studio portrait of the pianist Alexander Zakin.
media.publicCaption: Alexander Zakin performed in the 1929 Vierflügeltango for four grand pianos and in the ERKLA-Quartett concert at Hamborn in December 1929, where he played alongside Kaper. Max Dupain made this later portrait in July 1947.
media.publicCreditLine: Max Dupain, July 1947; Mitchell Library, State Library of New South Wales, ON 558/Box 13/no. 90; via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The Wikimedia Commons file carries only the Australian public-domain tag, which is correct for Australia — copyright in photographs taken before 1955 ran fifty years from creation, so this 1947 portrait became free there on 1 January 1998 — but the file makes no claim for the United States, and none can be made: because the photograph was still protected in Australia on 1 January 1996, the URAA restored its United States copyright. Max Dupain died in 1992. The holding library asks to be acknowledged. A reduced-resolution reproduction (500 × 674 px, from 3710 × 5000 px) is used here for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator.
